title: Supreme Court Judges Leave Pension and Privilege Amendment Order 2013

sections.shortTitle: Supreme Court Judges Leave Pension and Privilege Amendment Order 2013
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PRESIDENT'S ORDER NO
PRESIDENT'S ORDER NO.7 OF 2013
SUPREME COURT JUDGES (LEAVE, PENSION AND PRIVILEGE) (AMENDMENT) ORDER,
2013
An Order further to amend the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Par 9th October, 2013]
No
. F.2(2)/2013-Pub
. Dated 7-10-2013.---The following President's Order promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general
information:--
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997 (P.O. No.2 of 1997), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
NOW, THEREFORE, in
exercise of the powers conferred by the
Fifth Schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make the
following Order:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the Supreme Court Judges
(Leave, Pension and Privilege) (Amendment) Order, 2013.
(2) It shall come
into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the first day of July, 2013.
